node.statement: Enumerate the finite class family as C_1,...,C_q. Applying lem-maincb-stage3-finite-recombination to the explicit partition state and the per-class reset isomorphisms gives B=oplus_{a=1}^q M_{|C_a|} and a current reset isomorphism v:B->A_J with recorded epsilon_J^out<=W.L*epsilon, map defect d_J^out<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_J^out, and ||v(I_B)-u_{A_J}||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_J^out.
